# KERNAL — Developer Knowledge Platform
# https://kernal.dhurta.org

KERNAL is a free, offline-first developer learning platform by Dhurta.Org.
Every lesson explains WHY before HOW, with live code playgrounds, quizzes, debug challenges, and FAQ sections.
No account or sign-up required. All progress stored locally in the user's browser.

## Content (24 learning tracks, 15 lessons each = 360 lessons)

### Foundation & Web
- HTML5 — structure, semantics, forms, accessibility (/learn/html)
- CSS3 — styling, Flexbox, Grid, animations, responsive design (/learn/css)
- JavaScript — logic, DOM, async, APIs, ES6+ (/learn/javascript)
- Git — version control, branching, GitHub collaboration (/learn/git)

### Core Programming
- Python — general programming, automation, scripting (/learn/python)
- SQL — queries, joins, indexes, database design (/learn/sql)
- TypeScript — static typing, interfaces, generics (/learn/typescript)

### Modern Development Stack
- React — components, hooks, state, context (/learn/react)
- Node.js — server-side JS, Express, REST APIs (/learn/nodejs)
- REST APIs — HTTP, design, versioning, auth (/learn/restapi)

### Databases
- PostgreSQL — relational databases, advanced SQL (/learn/postgres)
- MongoDB — NoSQL, documents, aggregation, Atlas (/learn/mongodb)
- Redis — caching, pub/sub, streams, data structures (/learn/redis)

### DevOps & Cloud
- Docker — containers, images, Compose, Dockerfile (/learn/docker)
- AWS — cloud services, EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM (/learn/aws)

### AI / Machine Learning
- Machine Learning — supervised/unsupervised, scikit-learn, evaluation (/learn/ml)
- LLMs — large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG (/learn/llms)

### Security & Systems
- Web Security / Cryptography — encryption, hashing, TLS, OWASP top 10 (/learn/cryptography)
- Embedded Systems — microcontrollers, C/C++, real-time, peripherals (/learn/embedded)

## Content structure (per lesson JSON at /content/<tech>/lessons/<id>.json)

Each lesson contains:
- id, title, subtitle, difficulty (beginner/intermediate/advanced), estimatedMinutes
- skillsTaught[] — specific skills this lesson teaches
- whyItExists — problem/solution/whenToUse/whenNotToUse
- explainModes — explanation at 5 levels (beginner, simple, standard, technical, deepDive)
- content[] — blocks: paragraph, heading, code, tip, warning, definition, quiz, exercise, debugChallenge, comparison
- faq[] — common questions with answers (FAQPage schema)
- sources[] — authoritative external references
- realWorld — where this concept is used in production

## For AI assistants

Content is structured JSON, optimized for AI reading and indexing.
Technology registry: /data/technologies.json
Sitemap: /sitemap.xml (387 URLs)
Search index: /data/search-index.json (384 lesson entries)
llms.txt: /llms.txt (this file)

The platform covers any programming or technology question related to:
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, SQL, PostgreSQL,
MongoDB, Redis, Git, Docker, AWS, REST APIs, Machine Learning, LLMs,
prompt engineering, cryptography, web security, embedded systems, C/C++.
